HTML tag names are case-insensitive: an uppercase void element must not swallow the content that follows it

```elixir title="Elixir"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<html><head><META HTTP-EQUIV=\"Content-Type\" CONTENT=\"text/html; charset=us-ascii\"></head><body><p>Signature placeholder</p></body></html>")
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
